question: Which AI agents create the most value?
html:
Which AI agents create the most value

By company, the Thomas Scientific and Frontline agent sets create the most value, at about $3.8M and $3.6M a year (est.) of a $12.7M portfolio total (Portfolio AI-agent plan). The context does not show a ranking of individual agents. Only 2 of 61 items are visible. The best-evidenced single agent is the Punctual Pros missed-call agent.

Value by company

CompanyEst. annual valueRoadmap range
Thomas Scientific$3.84M$1.25–4.8M
Frontline$3.59M$1.5–4.2M
BPI$2.27M$0.85–3.75M
CET$1.32M$0.62–2.62M
Punctual Pros$0.88M$0.32–1.12M
Fair Harbor$0.77M$0.40–1.75M

All figures are est. EBITDA-equivalent run-rate after ramp. They are not de-duplicated (Portfolio AI-agent plan).

Value by rollout wave

  • Wave 3, the revenue agents, is largest at $4.19M (est.).
  • Wave 2, finance, follows at $3.91M (est.).
  • Wave 1, inbound-contact and document agents, adds $2.81M (est.). It has the clearest baselines and lowest risk.
  • Wave 4, monitoring services, is $1.77M (est.) (Portfolio AI-agent plan).

Strongest single-agent case

  • The Punctual Pros missed-call and after-hours booking agent is a Wave 1 agent. It answers overflow calls and books them into dispatch (Portfolio AI-agent plan).
  • The voice model recovers about $1.37M a year of job revenue (est.). That is $390k after-hours and $982k daytime or storm overflow. Outbound member renewals add about $403k (est.) (Voice AI research).
  • These are revenue figures, not EBITDA. They do not reconcile directly to the $0.88M Punctual Pros total.
  • The model rests on about 3,502 calls a month and a 14.8% missed share. Both are backed out of an est. ~$22M revenue figure, not taken from call logs (Voice AI research).

Limits of the evidence

  • Volumes behind every agent value are analyst estimates. Most outcome rates come from unaudited vendor case studies (Portfolio AI-agent plan; Voice AI research).
  • A true top-ten agent list needs the per-agent estimated-value field for all 61 items. It should then be checked against system-of-record counts for calls, tickets, invoices and quotes.
  • Punctual Pros gets the most agents per dollar of revenue. That reflects where home-services margin is won. It does not mean those agents have the highest absolute value.

Next actions

  1. Pull the full 61-item agent list and rank the agents by estimated value, with company and wave tags.
  2. Replace the Thomas Scientific and Frontline volume assumptions with system-of-record counts first, since they drive 58% of total est. value.
  3. Pull Punctual Pros phone-system data to test the 14.8% missed-call share before the Wave 1 launch.
  4. De-duplicate overlapping agent values so the $12.7M figure can be used in value-creation plans.
